test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In the ancient times, which river was also known as 'Ponni' in Tamil which is the fourth largest river flowing in the southeast direction through the states of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kaveri River.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Cauvery** is known as 'Ponni' in Tamil. 
 
• It is the fourth-largest river (Length: 805 km) in south India. Originating in the Western Ghats at Talakaveri in Karnataka's Kodagu district, it passes through Tamil Nadu.
 
• Tamil Nadu gets most of its rain from the Northeast monsoon.
 
• The river **originates in the Nandi Hills in the Chikkaballapura district of Karnataka** and flows through Tamil Nadu before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Sutlej or Satluj River is the longest of the five rivers that flow through the historic crossroads region of Punjab in northern India and Pakistan.
 
• The Ravi River is a transboundary river crossing northwestern India and eastern Pakistan. It is one of five rivers associated with the Punjab region.
 
• The Tapti River is a river in central India located to the south of the Narmada river that flows westwards before draining into the Arabian Sea.
